messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: High error rate (502/504/500) observed at gateway for control-plane routes. Impact: customer API traffic experiencing increased failures. Paging eng-oncall and SRE. Severity: P1.
oncall-bot: Alert details: 1862345678 - gateway-5xx-spike - rate: 14% 5xx over 5m, elevated tail latencies. Top upstreams: auth-service, org-lookup, billing-config.

maya (eng-oncall): saw it. investigating now. starting with gateway logs and top upstream traces. any recent deploys? :eyes:

sam (sre): confirmed spike in 5xx from gateway at 23:12 UTC. Traces show large proportion are 504s from authz calls that are timing out at 1.8s. org-lookup also has a surge of errors and increased latencies.

ashok (infra): no infra deploys in last hour. I see two config changes earlier today to org-lookup caching TTLs (decreased) and billing feature flag toggled. Could be related.

leah (product): those TTL changes were to reduce staleness for org metadata; rollouts were canaryed but small. rolling back would be disruptive but we can consider a quick revert.

irina (support): multiple customers are DMing support about auth failures for admin APIs; highest-severity customers reporting 40-60% failures for auth-protected endpoints.

maya (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) add temporary circuit-breaker for auth upstream to fail fast, 2) increase auth timeout from 1.5s -> 3s to avoid 504s? (note that increased timeout might increase gateway latency), 3) enable cached org fallback for read-only paths, 4) rollback TTL change if necessary. executing step 1 now.

sam (sre): +1 on circuit-breaker. also suggest enabling retry with jitter for transient 50x from auth (2 retries) but only on non-idempotent-safe paths carefully. starting to flip breaker in gateway config.

ops-bot: command ack: deployed gateway circuit-breaker policy version 2026. scaffolding logs: ``STATUS: breaker-open for auth-service when error-rate > 10% for 30s``

maya (eng-oncall): breaker is in place. I'm seeing a small dip in overall 5xx but auth still has many timeouts. running a targeted scale for auth-service: spin additional auth pods.

ashok (infra): scaling auth pool +3 instances in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. provisioning...

sam (sre): stack traces show auth-service threads stuck waiting on org-lookup DB calls. org-lookup latency is up to 1.2s median and many 5xx.

jordan (platform): org-lookup DB had a small write storm this AM from a billing sync job — I see a backlog. can we pause the sync?

leah (product): billing sync job is the nightly customer billing enrichment that started early this run. we can pause it for 15m to let the backlog drain. pausing now.

ops-bot: billing-sync job paused by leah.

maya (eng-oncall): after pausing the sync, org-lookup latency is trending down slowly. auth error rate decreased from 14% -> 7% in last 6 minutes. still above baseline.

irina (support): letting customers know we are mitigating; posting status update: "We are investigating elevated API errors affecting auth-protected routes. Mitigation in progress; potential reduced availability for a subset of administrative endpoints."

maya (eng-oncall): additional mitigation: re-enable cached org fallback: gateway will serve slightly stale org metadata (30s TTL) for non-sensitive requests to avoid sync with org-lookup on every request. rolling that config now.

sam (sre): watch for consistency regressions but this should cut down load on org-lookup. also recommend temporarily routing new non-critical read requests to dedicated read-only path that uses cached data.

jordan (platform): adding read-only route rule in routing table. patch applied.

(small pause)

maya (eng-oncall): auth 5xx down to ~3.5%. gateway overall errors down to 2%. customer-impacting errors reduced but still not fully recovered. marking mitigation in-progress.

irina (support): Received confirmation from two enterprise customers that errors are reduced, they're continuing to monitor.

sam (sre): root-cause hypothesis: combination of decreased org-lookup caching TTL + unexpectedly heavy billing-sync write storm causing org-lookup DB contention, cascading to auth-service which synchronously consults org-lookup on token validation paths, causing timeouts and gateway 5xxs.

leah (product): agreed. action items: 1) revert TTL change to previous (increase TTL) 2) harden billing-sync to backoff on DB contention 3) add async org-lookup caching layer and circuit-breaker on auth->org-lookup calls to prevent cascading failures.

maya (eng-oncall): started TTL revert now. applying change to config service: set org.lookup.ttl=60s (was 5s).

ops-bot: config deploy triggered: deploy id cfg-7862 to config-service and org-lookup with TTL revert.

ashok (infra): watching deploy, canarying to 10% traffic.

sam (sre): we should keep the circuit-breaker but adjust thresholds long-term. also create an automated alert to detect org-lookup queue depth and billing-sync throughput mismatch.

maya (eng-oncall): agree. I'm updating runbook notes with the steps we took and adding a checklist for future incidents.

irina (support): posting follow-up status: "Mitigations applied — auth and gateway error rates significantly improved. We will continue to monitor for residual impact. ETA to resolution TBD."

jordan (platform): will follow up with a postmortem PR and a short-term task list: revert TTL (done), add backpressure in billing-sync, async cache for org-lookup, increase auth timeouts slightly, add better alerting.

maya (eng-oncall): ok moving to post-incident handoff. sam, can you take lead on postmortem? I'll hand off oncall in 15m.

sam (sre): taking postmortem lead. will gather traces, deploy diffs, and customer impact timeline.

maya (eng-oncall): handing off to sam. I'm going offline for a bit to rest. thanks team. :heart: 

ops-bot: oncall-handoff: outgoing: maya (eng-oncall), incoming: sam (sre). Handoff note: mitigations applied (breaker, scale auth, pause billing-sync, revert TTL), customer impact reduced.

sam (sre): received handoff. I'll coordinate the incident writeup and follow-up actions. If anyone sees residual anomalies, ping me.

irina (support): closing customer-facing update: "Issue mitigated; we observed increased error rates for auth-protected endpoints earlier today. Root cause analysis and timeline forthcoming. If you continue to see issues, please contact support."

(15m later)

sam (sre): final check — system stabilized for 20m with errors at baseline. root cause confirmed: cache TTL reduction + billing-sync surge -> DB contention -> org-lookup timeouts -> auth timeouts -> gateway 5xx cascade. Postmortem tasks assigned in Jira: INF-934 (revert TTL permanent config), INF-935 (billing-sync backpressure), INF-936 (async org cache), INF-937 (alerting).

maya (eng-oncall): thanks all. I'll review the postmortem when ready.

oncall-bot: Incident 1862345678 status: Resolved — monitoring.

sam (sre): closing thread. great cross-team response — quick mitigations prevented broader outage.
